snippet.title: Ken McElroy
snippet.description: Ken McElroy is a principal at The Founders Group, best-selling author, entrepreneur, and real estate investor with more than two decades of experience. Through practical advice, expert conversations, real-world successes, and hard-earned lessons, Ken delivers straightforward education on real estate, economics, personal finance, entrepreneurship, and building long-term wealth. No hype. Just real experience and actionable insight for investors at every level.
